# Agustin Castiarena

> Senior Frontend Engineer with 10+ years building and evolving modern web applications across e-commerce, media, healthcare, and insurance. Based in Trevelin, Patagonia, Argentina.

Personal portfolio: bio, work history, projects and web experiments. This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention so AI assistants can read a concise, accurate summary instead of parsing rendered HTML. It is hand-maintained and may lag the live site by a little; treat `/bio/`, `/projects/` and `/experiments/` as the source of truth for anything time-sensitive.

## Bio

- [Bio](https://castiarena.github.io/bio/): Full background — summary, work history timeline, key achievements, skills and training. CV: [PDF](https://castiarena.github.io/cv/agustin-castiarena-resume.pdf).

Focus areas: React ecosystems, GraphQL-based architectures, performance optimization, developer experience, and technical leadership (mentoring, hiring, cross-functional delivery). Led frontend architecture and modernization work on business-critical products.

Recent roles (newest first):

- Senior Fullstack Engineer, Riverside.fm (2023–2026) — Recording Studio platform architecture, GraphQL-powered microservices, livestream integrations, AI-assisted engineering workflows.
- Frontend Team Lead, Realworld One (2021–2023) — client-facing VR/AR healthcare platform, team growth and delivery planning.
- Senior Frontend Engineer, Westwing Home & Living (2020–2021) — micro frontend architecture migration, shared UI kit.
- Fullstack Engineer, AXA (2018–2019) — JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration, BDD/Gherkin end-to-end testing.
- Senior Frontend Engineer, Mercado Libre (2015–2018) — purchase flow across Latin American markets, large-scale E2E test suite.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/): Case studies with role, stack, approach and outcomes. The exporter and Next eclipse write-ups are complete case studies. The other three are still placeholders pending publishable detail (much of the underlying work is under NDA) — their CV-derived summaries below are accurate; treat any "TODO" text on their live pages as not yet final.
  - [exporter Chrome extension](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/exporter/): A Chrome extension that exports any web page, or just the elements you pick, to a clean PDF with selectable text, entirely on-device. Published on the Chrome Web Store.
  - [Next eclipse](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/next-eclipse/): A live countdown to the next solar or lunar eclipse with an interactive 3D globe showing where it is visible, built on NASA eclipse catalogs and hosted as a static site.
  - [Recording Studio architecture](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/recording-studio-architecture/): Decomposed core business logic into GraphQL-powered microservices at Riverside.fm, enabling a more modular platform architecture.
  - [VR/AR healthcare platform](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/vr-ar-healthcare-platform/): Built and evolved a client-facing VR/AR healthcare platform at Realworld One.
  - [Micro frontend migration](https://castiarena.github.io/projects/micro-frontend-migration/): Led frontend work in Westwing's migration to a decentralized micro frontend architecture.
